title: The Killing of General Qassim Suleimani

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日新闻简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 NYTimes.com 上直播部分精选访谈，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: From Iraq to Washington, consequences are mounting.
sentences.zh: 从伊拉克到华盛顿，影响正在不断扩大。

sentences.en: After the United States assassinated Iranian General Qasem Soleimani,
sentences.zh: 在美国暗杀伊朗将军卡西姆·苏莱曼尼之后，

sentences.en: Helene Cooper, on why President Trump chose to do it.
sentences.zh: 海伦·库珀将为你讲述特朗普总统为何会做出这一决定。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月6日，星期一。

sentences.en: Helene, what do we know about what led up to this extraordinary decision by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 海伦，对于导致美国做出这一非同寻常决定的前因后果，

sentences.en: to take out General Soleimani?
sentences.zh: 即对苏莱曼尼将军采取行动，我们都知道些什么？

sentences.en: Well, from what we've been able to piece together over the past few days is all of this started on December 27th.
sentences.zh: 好的，根据我们过去几天拼凑出的情况，这一切都始于12月27日。

sentences.en: And Justin DeFox, an American contractor, was just killed in northern Iraq in a rocket attack.
sentences.zh: 当时一名美国承包商贾斯汀·德福克斯在伊拉克北部的一场火箭弹袭击中丧生。

sentences.en: And several U.S.
sentences.zh: 并且有几名美军

sentences.en: troops were also injured.
sentences.zh: 士兵也受伤了。

sentences.en: When an Iranian-backed Shiite militia group launched an attack in Iraq that ended up killing an American contractor.
sentences.zh: 当时一个伊朗支持的什叶派民兵组织在伊拉克发动了一次袭击，最终导致一名美国承包商身亡。

sentences.en: This is just the latest in a spate of similar rocket attacks, but it's the first time that we're actually seeing U.S.
sentences.zh: 这只是近期频发的同类火箭弹袭击中的最新起因，但这是我们首次真正看到美军

sentences.en: casualties.
sentences.zh: 人员伤亡。

sentences.en: Right after this happened, the Pentagon drew up the perennial list of options that the Defense Department is always keeping
sentences.zh: 就在事件发生后不久，五角大楼开出了国防部一贯备好的长期待选项清单，

sentences.en: for the president to respond and decide what he's going to do in order to respond to the attack.
sentences.zh: 供总统做出回应并决定如何对此次袭击采取反制措施。

sentences.en: General Mark Milley, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, and Defense Secretary Mark Esper, both flew to Mar-a-Lago, where President Trump was spending the holidays,
sentences.zh: 参谋长联席会议主席马克·米利将军和国防部长马克·埃斯珀一同飞往特朗普总统度假的马阿拉歌庄园，

sentences.en: and met with him, presenting him this list of how do you respond to what the administration immediately determined was an Iranian-backed attack.
sentences.zh: 并与他会面，向他提交了一份应对方案清单，以回应政府迅速认定为伊朗支持的袭击事件。

sentences.en: One option included striking Iranian ships.
sentences.zh: 其中一个选项包括打击伊朗船只。

sentences.en: Another option was striking perhaps a missile site or two, or looking for a way to launch airstrikes against the Iranian-backed Shiite militias in Iraq that had started this.
sentences.zh: 另一个选项可能是打击一两个导弹阵地，或者是寻找途径对发动此次袭击的伊拉克境内伊朗支持的什叶派民兵发动空袭。

sentences.en: Also on the list was one extreme option, which was to launch an attack, which will really be a targeted assassination, actually, of General Qasem Soleimani,
sentences.zh: 清单上还有一个极端选项，那就是发动一次袭击，实际上就是对卡西姆·苏莱曼尼将军进行真正意义上的定点清除，

sentences.en: who is the head of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' Quds Force.
sentences.zh: 他当时担任伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队圣城旅的指挥官。

sentences.en: And it's basically Iran's very muscular yet covert arm of the Iranian military.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是伊朗军事力量中非常强硬且隐蔽的一个分支。

sentences.en: He's in essence the most senior military commander in Iran.
sentences.zh: 他本质上是伊朗最高级别的军事指挥官。

sentences.en: This is something that the Defense Department often does, is they will put an extreme option on the table because they will always give all options to the president,
sentences.zh: 这是五角大楼经常做的事情，他们会把一个极端选项摆上台面，因为他们总是会向总统提供所有的选项，

sentences.en: but it's almost sort of their way of nudging the president toward an option that they prefer.
sentences.zh: 但这几乎也是他们引导总统倾向于他们更喜欢的一个选项的方式。

sentences.en: If you put something that's viewed as a little bit crazy out there, then you get him to do what you want.
sentences.zh: 如果你抛出一个被认为有点疯狂的方案，那么你就能让他按你的意愿行事。

sentences.en: President Trump at the time did not choose the nuclear option.
sentences.zh: 当时的特朗普总统并没有选择核选项。

sentences.en: What we did was take a decisive response that makes clear what President Trump has said for months and months and months,
sentences.zh: 我们所做的是采取果断的回应，这明确表达了特朗普总统几个月来一直在强调的一点，

sentences.en: which is that we will not stand for the Islamic Republic of Iran to take actions that put American men and women in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们绝不容忍伊朗伊斯兰共和国采取危及美国男女军人生命的行动。

sentences.en: He went for let's launch an attack on the Shiite militia group that launched the attack that killed the American contractor.
sentences.zh: 他选择的是：让我们对那个发动了导致美国承包商死亡袭击的什叶派民兵组织发动攻击。

sentences.en: The Pentagon says it carried out military strikes in Iraq and Syria, targeting a militia group.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼表示，它在伊拉克和叙利亚针对一个民兵组织实施了军事打击。

sentences.en: A spokesman for the group says U.S.
sentences.zh: 该组织的一位发言人称，美军

sentences.en: airstrikes killed at least 25 of their fighters and hurt more than 50 others.
sentences.zh: 空袭造成至少25名武装人员死亡，50多人受伤。

sentences.en: This happened in Iraq and Syria yesterday.
sentences.zh: 这昨天发生在伊拉克和叙利亚。

sentences.en: So the president in the end chooses a pretty measured kind of tit-for-tat response.
sentences.zh: 所以总统最终选择了一种相当克制的、针锋相对的回应。

sentences.en: We were attacked by missiles, so we will attack with missiles.
sentences.zh: 我们遭到导弹袭击，所以我们也将用导弹回击。

sentences.en: Exactly, and we will attack who attacked us.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且我们要打击袭击我们的人。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: I would add that in our discussion today with the president, we discussed with him other options that are available.
sentences.zh: 我要补充的是，在我们今天与总统的讨论中，我们与他探讨了其他可用的选项。

sentences.en: And I would note also that we will take additional actions as necessary to ensure that we act in our own self-defense and we deter further bad behavior from militia groups or from Iran.
sentences.zh: 我还要指出，我们将在必要时采取进一步行动，以确保我们进行自我防卫，并遏制民兵组织或伊朗进一步的不良行为。

sentences.en: So then a couple of days later, President Trump is still at Mar-a-Lago and he's watching TV.
sentences.zh: 几天后，特朗普总统仍然留在马阿拉歌庄园看着电视。

sentences.en: He's still angry about the initial Shiite militia attack that killed the American contractor.
sentences.zh: 他依然对那起导致美国承包商丧生的最初什叶派民兵袭击感到愤怒。

sentences.en: But now he's seeing on TV all of these video images of Iranian-backed protesters attacking the American embassy in Baghdad.
sentences.zh: 但现在他在电视上看到了所有关于伊朗支持的抗议者冲击巴格达美国大使馆的视频画面。

sentences.en: A chaotic scene as protesters stormed the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，巴格达的美国大使馆遭抗议者冲击，现场一片混乱，

sentences.en: embassy in Baghdad today, scaling the walls, forcing the gates, and setting fires inside the heavily guarded compound while diplomats were trapped inside.
sentences.zh: 外交官被困在戒备森严的大院内，抗议者攀爬高墙、强行砸开大门并在内部纵火。

sentences.en: Some protesters were chanting death to America.
sentences.zh: 一些抗议者高喊打倒美国。

sentences.en: And one of the first things that come to his mind is Benghazi and the attack on the American consulate in Benghazi in 2011 that led to the death of four Americans,
sentences.zh: 他脑海中浮现的第一件事就是班加西事件，以及2011年美国驻班加西领事馆遭遇袭击导致四名美国人死亡的事件，

sentences.en: including the ambassador to Libya.
sentences.zh: 其中包括美国驻利比亚大使。

sentences.en: Which was an attack of protesters.
sentences.zh: 那是一场抗议者的袭击。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: On an American, essentially, embassy-like building.
sentences.zh: 本质上是对类似美国大使馆建筑的袭击。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How would you have handled that if you were watching in real time Americans under fire at the American consul and an ambassador under fire?
sentences.zh: 如果你当时在实时观看美国人在美国领事馆遭受火力攻击、大使也遭受火力攻击，你会怎么处理？

sentences.en: Well, it would have never taken place because I think...
sentences.zh: 嗯，这根本就不会发生，因为我认为……

sentences.en: President Trump, during his campaign and for years after the initial attack in Benghazi, really went after Hillary Clinton, who was Secretary of State at the time,
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间以及班加西最初袭击发生后的多年里，特朗普总统一直猛烈抨击时任国务卿希拉里·克林顿，

sentences.en: for not doing enough to prevent that.
sentences.zh: 指责她没有采取足够措施来阻止那场悲剧。

sentences.en: And this had been a rallying cry during his 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 这曾是他2016年竞选期间的一个战斗口号。

sentences.en: So this was a pretty big deal for him.
sentences.zh: 所以这对他的意义非常重大。

sentences.en: Horribly handled.
sentences.zh: 处理得太糟糕了。

sentences.en: A horrible leadership.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的领导。

sentences.en: She's a horrible leader.
sentences.zh: 她是个糟糕的领导人。

sentences.en: So he's watching now these attacks that are happening under his own watch.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他看着这些在他自己眼皮底下发生的袭击。

sentences.en: And he's thinking about Benghazi, according to his aides that we talked to.
sentences.zh: 根据我们采访过的他的助手透露，他在想着班加西。

sentences.en: He's also thinking about the 1979 attack on the American embassy in Iran that led to the hostage crisis.
sentences.zh: 他还在想着1979年导致人质危机的美国驻伊朗大使馆遇袭事件。

sentences.en: He's getting more and more angry, according to his aides.
sentences.zh: 据他的助手称，他变得越来越愤怒。

sentences.en: And then he calls for his menu of options again.
sentences.zh: 然后他再次要求调出他的选项菜单。

sentences.en: And this time he picks the extreme option.
sentences.zh: 这一次他选择了极端选项。

sentences.en: And so this is the moment when the president calls for the strike on Soleimani, this top general.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是总统下令对顶级将领苏莱曼尼实施打击的时刻。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Pentagon officials and administration officials were very surprised because it's one thing to give an option to a president.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼官员和政府官员非常震惊，因为向总统提供一个选项是一回事，

sentences.en: It's another thing for him to actually do it.
sentences.zh: 而他真的付诸行动则是另一回事。

sentences.en: They had put that option on the menu for President Trump, not thinking that he would take it.
sentences.zh: 他们把那个选项放进特朗普总统的菜单里时，根本没想过他会采纳。

sentences.en: And now he has taken it.
sentences.zh: 而现在他真的采纳了。

sentences.en: So the Defense Department went into action.
sentences.zh: 于是国防部迅速行动起来。

sentences.en: This is something that the American Defense Department, quite tragically almost, is very good at doing.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是带着某种悲剧色彩，是美国国防部非常擅长做的一件事。

sentences.en: We know how to kill people.
sentences.zh: 我们懂得如何杀人。

sentences.en: And we have been tracking for more than a decade, almost two decades, Qasem Soleimani.
sentences.zh: 而且我们对卡西姆·苏莱曼尼的追踪已经超过十年，快要二十年了。

sentences.en: So intelligence-wise, we had intelligence reports that he would be flying into Baghdad International Airport that night.
sentences.zh: 所以在情报方面，我们收到的情报报告显示他会在当晚乘机飞往巴格达国际机场。

sentences.en: There was some question now as the military is setting up just sort of the mechanics of how this strike is going to be conducted.
sentences.zh: 现在，当军方正在筹备此次打击的具体实施细节时，出现了一些疑问。

sentences.en: The Pentagon had determined that if he was met, for instance, by Iraqi officials who were friendly towards the United States, they would not go ahead with the strike.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼曾决定，如果他比如受到亲美伊拉克官员的迎接，他们就会取消这次打击。

sentences.en: If he was not, they would.
sentences.zh: 如果没有，他们就会执行。

sentences.en: But when General Soleimani's plane landed, he was met by the head of one of Iraq's Iranian-backed Shia militias, who was viewed by the United States as somebody who,
sentences.zh: 但当苏莱曼尼将军的飞机降落时，迎接他的是伊拉克境内一个伊朗支持的什叶派民兵组织头目，此人被美国视为一个，

sentences.en: I think the phrase they used was a clean party, meaning it's okay to kill him.
sentences.zh: 我想他们用的词是“干净的目标”，意思是可以杀掉他。

sentences.en: It's kind of a weird way of saying it.
sentences.zh: 这种说法听起来有点奇怪。

sentences.en: So a clean party means somebody we don't mind killing.
sentences.zh: 所以“干净的目标”意味着我们不介意杀掉的人。

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: And so they authorized the strike and blew up the two-car convoy as it was leaving Baghdad International Airport.
sentences.zh: 于是他们授权了这次打击，在两辆车组成的车队离开巴格达国际机场时将其炸毁。

sentences.en: In a dramatic escalation of tensions in the Middle East, a U.S.
sentences.zh: 随着中东紧张局势急剧升级，美军

sentences.en: airstrike has killed Iran's most important military commander.
sentences.zh: 空袭炸死了伊朗最重要的军事指挥官。

sentences.en: This was a swift, precise military strike that has huge, unpredictable, and possibly long-term consequences.
sentences.zh: 这是一次迅速、精确的军事打击，会产生巨大、不可预测且可能是长期的后果。

sentences.en: So help us to understand the significance of this decision by the president.
sentences.zh: 所以请帮我们理解总统这一决定的重要性。

sentences.en: Why was this ever an option given to him, even if it was the most extreme option?
sentences.zh: 为什么这会成为提供给他的选项之一，即使它是最极端的选项？

sentences.en: And why do we think he chose it?
sentences.zh: 我们认为他为什么会选择这个选项？

sentences.en: It's hard to explain why President Trump chose to take this option.
sentences.zh: 很难解释特朗普总统为什么会选择这个选项。

sentences.en: I think many of us don't understand it ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我想我们中的许多人自己也无法理解。

sentences.en: The administration will tell you that he's a very bad guy, and there's no denying that.
sentences.zh: 政府会告诉你他是个大坏蛋，这确实无可否认。

sentences.en: The administration will also tell you that he's responsible for the death of hundreds of American troops.
sentences.zh: 政府还会告诉你，他要为数百名美军士兵的死亡负责。

sentences.en: That is true as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是事实。

sentences.en: The issue, though, that has been true for years and years as American troops have battled some Iranian-backed Shia militias in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 然而多年来一直存在的问题是，美军在伊拉克与一些伊朗支持的什叶派民兵进行了交战。

sentences.en: And both Presidents Bush and Obama made the decision not to kill Soleimani because he was a general with the Iranian military.
sentences.zh: 小布什和奥巴马两位总统都曾决定不杀死苏莱曼尼，因为他是伊朗军方的一名将军。

sentences.en: And the United States traditionally does not go around assassinating military generals.
sentences.zh: 而且美国传统上不会四处暗杀军事将军。

sentences.en: The last time we did this was in 1943 during World War II when we took out a Japanese admiral.
sentences.zh: 我们上次这么做还是在1943年二战期间，当时我们除掉了一名日本海军中将。

sentences.en: Iran is a sovereign state.
sentences.zh: 伊朗是一个主权国家。

sentences.en: Assassinating one of their officials is pretty much almost the same thing as assassinating the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff or, you know,
sentences.zh: 暗杀他们的官员几乎就等于暗杀参谋长联席会议主席或者，你知道的，

sentences.en: a high-ranking American official and then own up to it and take credit for it.
sentences.zh: 一名美国高级官员，然后承认并把功劳揽在自己身上。

sentences.en: It's just not something that is normally often done in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 这通常不是在光天化日之下会做的事情。

sentences.en: But we should also remember that just a month ago, President Trump authorized the killing of Baghdadi, the ISIS head, and he got a lot of very good and deserved credit for that.
sentences.zh: 但我们也应该记住，就在一个月前，特朗普总统授权击毙了极端组织“伊斯兰国”头目巴格达迪，他为此获得了许多实至名归的赞誉。

sentences.en: The administration now today will try to make the equivalent that General Soleimani is the same as Baghdadi, that he's a terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 现如今政府试图将其同等看待，声称苏莱曼尼和巴格达迪一样是个恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And he has certainly been behind many proxy terrorist acts by Iranian-backed groups in Yemen, in Lebanon, in Iraq, and in Syria.
sentences.zh: 而且他在也门、黎巴嫩、伊拉克和叙利亚，确实一直是伊朗支持的各组织背后许多代理人恐怖袭击的策划者。

sentences.en: So that has been increasing in recent months as the United States has choked off Iran economically.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着美国在经济上对伊朗进行绞杀，这种情况在最近几个月一直在加剧。

sentences.en: We're following multiple breaking stories, including Iran's seizure of at least one oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz today.
sentences.zh: 我们正在关注多起突发新闻，包括今天伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡扣押了至少一艘油轮。

sentences.en: And there are now conflicting reports about whether a second tanker was seized.
sentences.zh: 目前对于是否扣押了第二艘油轮，各方报道相互矛盾。

sentences.en: Iran is clearly messaging that they hold cards here.
sentences.zh: 伊朗显然在传达这样一个信息：他们手里有筹码。

sentences.en: But as this continues to go on, what will Iran continue to do?
sentences.zh: 但随着事态持续发展，伊朗接下来会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, you know, Brianna, I think it's important that we understand what's motivating Iran right now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，布里安娜，我认为理解目前是什么在驱动伊朗是很重要的。

sentences.en: Look, since the United States pulled out of the Iran nuclear deal and the administration imposed new sanctions on Iran, those sanctions have absolutely crippled Iran's economy.
sentences.zh: 你看，自从美国退出伊朗核协议并对伊朗实施新的制裁以来，这些制裁彻底瘫痪了伊朗的经济。

sentences.en: That led the Iranian regime to start, as a lot of people at the Pentagon say, acting out.
sentences.zh: 这导致伊朗政权开始像五角大楼许多人所说的那样“胡作非为”。

sentences.en: And you saw an increase in attacks from Iran, which has been sort of punching out because it was being punched.
sentences.zh: 你看到了来自伊朗的袭击有所增加，这就像是因为挨了打而进行的反击。

sentences.en: And that is one of the reasons that the administration is now given for why this strike was taken.
sentences.zh: 这也是政府现在给出的发动此次打击的原因之一。

sentences.en: The other big reason, though, leads back to this, which is that the administration is saying that Soleimani was planning additional,
sentences.zh: 不过另一个重大原因则指向这一点，即政府称苏莱曼尼正在策划更多的、

sentences.en: even more high-profile attacks on the United States and on American interests and assets in the region, and that this was eminent.
sentences.zh: 甚至更加备受瞩目的针对美国以及该地区美国利益和资产的袭击，而且这是迫在眉睫的。

sentences.en: We could see that he was continuing down this path, that there were, in fact,
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到他一直在沿着这条路走下去，事实上确实有

sentences.en: plots that he was working on that were aimed directly at significant harm to American interests throughout the region, not just in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 他正在策划的阴谋，直指对整个地区（而不仅仅是伊拉克）的美国利益造成重大损害。

sentences.en: You know, you're hearing that from General Milley, the head of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你从参谋长联席会议主席米利将军那里听到了这种说法。

sentences.en: You heard that on Sunday from Secretary of State Pompeo.
sentences.zh: 国务卿蓬佩奥在周日也这样说过。

sentences.en: We would have been culpably negligent had we not taken this action.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不采取这一行动，我们就是犯下了玩忽职守的罪过。

sentences.en: The American people would have said that we weren't doing the right thing to protect and defend American lives.
sentences.zh: 美国人民会说我们没有做正确的事情来保护和捍卫美国人的生命。

sentences.en: Which is the argument that Soleimani was about to launch another imminent attack on American interests.
sentences.zh: 这就是苏莱曼尼即将对美国利益发动又一次迫在眉睫袭击的论点。

sentences.en: Helene, of all the rationales that we've heard from the Trump administration, this seems to be the most important in terms of explaining why we would do this now,
sentences.zh: 海伦，在特朗普政府给出的所有理由中，这似乎是最重要的一个，用以解释为什么我们会在此时此地采取行动，

sentences.en: take out Soleimani.
sentences.zh: 除掉苏莱曼尼。

sentences.en: But, of course, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但当然，美国

sentences.en: has a very complicated history of using potential threats to American interests as a rationale for actions overseas, especially in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 有着一段非常复杂的历史，总是以对美国利益的潜在威胁作为在海外采取行动的理由，特别是在中东地区。

sentences.en: So what does your reporting show about how we should be thinking about this explanation of an imminent attack?
sentences.zh: 那么你的报道显示，我们应该如何看待这种关于“迫在眉睫的袭击”的解释？

sentences.en: That's such an interesting and key question, how we should be thinking about the administration rationale for this attack.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣且关键的问题，我们该如何看待政府对此类袭击的理由。

sentences.en: Do we believe them or do we not?
sentences.zh: 我们是该相信他们还是不信？

sentences.en: Our reporting shows that it depends on where you stand.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道显示，这取决于你站在什么立场上看待。

sentences.en: There is no question that General Soleimani has planned and was continuing to plan attacks against the United States through these groups.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，苏莱曼尼将军曾经策划并通过这些组织继续策划针对美国的袭击。

sentences.en: But that's been going on for more than 15 years.
sentences.zh: 但这种情况已经持续了15年以上。

sentences.en: So the question then becomes, why now?
sentences.zh: 那么问题来了，为什么是现在？

sentences.en: The administration says there was something imminent and big that was about to happen.
sentences.zh: 政府表示，有一件迫在眉睫的大事即将发生。

sentences.en: And they appear to be basing that on intelligence reports that they've received about General Soleimani's travels in the last few days leading up to the attack that took his life.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎是根据最近几天收到的关于苏莱曼尼将军在袭击发生前的行踪的情报报告得出的这一结论。

sentences.en: But these same intel sources also say that he had been asked by Ayatollah Khamenei, who's the supreme leader of Iran, to come back to Iran,
sentences.zh: 但这些情报来源同时也指出，伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊曾要求他返回伊朗，

sentences.en: that Khamenei had not authorized anything.
sentences.zh: 哈梅内伊并没有授权任何行动。

sentences.en: He had requested permission and he was not given it and he was told to come back to Iran.
sentences.zh: 他曾请求批准但未获准，并被告知返回伊朗。

sentences.en: So that then belies the whole question of imminent.
sentences.zh: 这就与“迫在眉睫”的说法完全矛盾了。

sentences.en: Does it become something that's happening in two days or something that hasn't even been approved yet?
sentences.zh: 这究竟是两之内会发生的事，还是连批准都还没批准的事？

sentences.en: So what the administration then will have to answer to the American people, if this leads to war, which it might, is whether or not this assassination was worth it.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果这场暗杀引发了战争——这并非不可能，政府将不得不向美国人民交代的是，这次暗杀是否真的值得。

sentences.en: Helene, what has been the response in the Middle East in the days since the U.S.
sentences.zh: 海伦，自美国杀死苏莱曼尼以来，

sentences.en: killed Soleimani?
sentences.zh: 中东地区的反应如何？

sentences.en: The response since the U.S.
sentences.zh: 自美国在中东杀死苏莱曼尼以来，

sentences.en: killed Soleimani in the Middle East has been huge.
sentences.zh: 引发的反应极其巨大。

sentences.en: In Iran, where protesters had two weeks ago been protesting against the regime, they have now united, apparently, behind the regime and turned their ire on the United States.
sentences.zh: 在伊朗，两周前还在抗议政权的抗议者，现在显然已经团结在政权身后，将愤怒转向了美国。

sentences.en: You're seeing these familiar views of American flags being burned in the streets.
sentences.zh: 你会看到街头焚烧美国国旗的熟悉画面。

sentences.en: This massive outpouring of mourners, it's certainly ramped up the anti-American sentiment in Iran.
sentences.zh: 哀悼者大规模涌上街头，这无疑加剧了伊朗的反美情绪。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Baghdad, you're seeing similar outpourings of griefs, but that's been accompanied by the Iraqi parliament,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在巴格达，你也能看到类似的悲痛情绪宣泄，伴随这一情况的是，伊拉克议会

sentences.en: voting unanimously this morning to expel the United States from Iraq.
sentences.zh: 今天上午一致投票决定将美国驱逐出伊拉克。

sentences.en: They didn't put forth a timeline for withdrawal, so there's still some wiggle room there.
sentences.zh: 他们没有提出撤军的时间表，所以其中仍然存在一些回旋余地。

sentences.en: But particularly the Shiites in the Iraqi government are very, very angry at the United States right now.
sentences.zh: 但特别是伊拉克政府中的什叶派，现在对美国感到非常非常愤怒。

sentences.en: You have to understand that Iraq is made up of three very distinct groups, Shiites, Sunnis, and Kurds, but it is predominantly Shiite.
sentences.zh: 你必须明白，伊拉克由三个截然不同的群体组成：什叶派、逊尼派和库尔德人，但其中以什叶派为主。

sentences.en: Iran is Shiite as well, and the Iraqi government is very close to Iran.
sentences.zh: 伊朗也是什叶派，伊拉克政府与伊朗关系非常密切。

sentences.en: The Shiites in Iraq are particularly close to General Soleimani and view him in many ways as one of their own.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克的什叶派与苏莱曼尼将军的关系尤其亲密，在许多方面将他视为自己人。

sentences.en: They're also upset, though, because this was a targeted killing in their country.
sentences.zh: 不过他们也很不满，因为这是一场在其境内进行的定点清除。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's in much the same way that if something like this happened in the United States, the United States government would be upset.
sentences.zh: 这就好比如果在美国发生这样的事情，美国政府也会感到不满。

sentences.en: That's another reason why the Iraqi government is so angry.
sentences.zh: 这也是伊拉克政府如此愤怒的另一个原因。

sentences.en: Helene, can Iraq and its legislature do that?
sentences.zh: 海伦，伊拉克及其立法机构能这么做吗？

sentences.en: Can they kick the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们能把美军赶出国家吗？

sentences.en: troops out of the country?
sentences.zh: 他们可以。

sentences.en: They can.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克可以表示你们不再受欢迎。

sentences.en: Iraq can say you are no longer welcome there.
sentences.zh: 记住，我们是在伊拉克政府的邀请下才驻留那里的，表面上是为了打击伊斯兰国。

sentences.en: Remember, we are there at the invitation of the Iraqi government ostensibly to fight the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 那场战斗基本上已经结束了。

sentences.en: That battle is largely over.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，伊拉克政府完全可以把美军赶出伊拉克。

sentences.en: So, yes, the Iraqi government can kick the United States military out of Iraq.
sentences.zh: 他们是否会这样做，这是否只是一种姿态，我目前还不知道。

sentences.en: Whether they do or not, whether this is posturing, I don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 每隔几个小时，你就会看到新的情况。

sentences.en: Every couple of hours, you see something else.
sentences.zh: 就在伊拉克议会投票后不久，我们看到五角大楼宣布暂停在伊拉克的打击ISIS联盟行动。

sentences.en: Right after the Iraqi parliament voted, we saw the Pentagon announced that it was suspending the anti-ISIS coalition effort in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 有4000名美军一直在那里，身处伊拉克的部队将专注于保护目前仍在该国内的美国公民，

sentences.en: There are 4,000 American troops who've been there and that the troops who are in Iraq will be focused on protecting the American citizens who are still in the country,
sentences.zh: 而这些公民正被建议尽快离开。

sentences.en: but who are being advised to leave as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 这就像是2013年的重演，当时奥巴马政府结束了战斗任务并从伊拉克撤军，随之而来的是ISIS的崛起。

sentences.en: It's like 2013 all over again when the Obama administration ended combat and pulled troops out of Iraq and you saw the rise of ISIS.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦美国撤出该国，其他派别就有了更大的活动空间和滋生空间。

sentences.en: Because once the United States is gone and out of the country, these other factions are given more room to maneuver and more room to thrive.
sentences.zh: 因此，你可以大致看出，如果为ISIS自由活动清除了地面障碍，这些事件可能会导致ISIS卷土重来。

sentences.en: And so you can sort of see how these events could lead to a resurgence of ISIS if the ground becomes clear for them to move around more freely.
sentences.zh: 苏莱曼尼不是还领导了一支作为ISIS敌人的伊朗民兵武装吗？

sentences.en: And wasn't Soleimani also leading an Iranian militia that was an enemy of ISIS?
sentences.zh: 是的，在打击ISIS的战斗中，苏莱曼尼和美国之间实际上存在某种合作。

sentences.en: Yes, there was a de facto cooperation between Soleimani and the United States in the fight against ISIS.
sentences.zh: 他们都反对ISIS，并且都在同一战场上打击ISIS。

sentences.en: They were both opposed to ISIS and they were both fighting ISIS on the same turf.
sentences.zh: 没错，这在狭隘而复杂的情况下意味着，尽管苏莱曼尼在许多其他方面是我们的敌人，但在打击ISIS的战斗中他曾是一个盟友。

sentences.en: Right, which would have made in a very narrow and complicated way Soleimani an ally in our fight against ISIS, even though he's our enemy in many other respects.
sentences.zh: 他在打击ISIS的战斗中曾是我们的盟友。

sentences.en: He was an ally in our fight against ISIS.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That is correct.
sentences.zh: 这一切产生的连锁反应非常复杂。

sentences.en: The ripple effects of all of this are very complicated.
sentences.zh: 但我想知道，是否有一种简单的方式来思考这个问题，那就是在美伊之间经过了几个月的挑衅与回应之后，

sentences.en: But I wonder if there's a simple way of thinking about this, which is that after all these months of provocation and response between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统觉得是时候让美国提醒伊朗，归根结底，

sentences.en: and Iran, that President Trump felt it was time for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们是军事超级大国，我们对他们的绝对优势是非凡的，这种优势构成了这样一种威慑：无论伊朗对此次事件最终作出什么反应，

sentences.en: to remind Iran that at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 都不会过于严重。

sentences.en: we are the military superpower and our advantages over them are extraordinary and represent the kind of deterrent that means whatever Iran's ultimate response to this is,
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，我们只是叫板了伊朗的虚张声势。

sentences.en: it will not be all that severe.
sentences.zh: 如果我们当初不是因为退出2005年（注：实为2015年）在奥巴马政府下签署的、

sentences.en: That in a sense, we just called Iran's bluff.
sentences.zh: 被特朗普总统和许多共和党人所痛恨的伊朗核协议而挑起这一切的话，这种说法或许还行得通。

sentences.en: That would work if we hadn't started this to begin with by pulling out of the Iranian nuclear deal, which was signed in 2015 under the Obama administration,
sentences.zh: 我在商界混迹多年。

sentences.en: which was hated by President Trump and many Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我懂如何做交易。

sentences.en: I have been in business a long time.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你们，这项协议对美国、以色列和整个中东来说都是灾难性的。

sentences.en: I know deal making.
sentences.zh: 他们认为该协议过于软弱，并表示该协议通过解除对伊朗停止铀浓缩的制裁给予了伊朗奖赏，却没有解决伊朗的不良行为。

sentences.en: And let me tell you, this deal is catastrophic for America, for Israel, and for the whole of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 而这正是苏莱曼尼式的那种在其他领域的恶劣行为。

sentences.en: They viewed it as too weak and said that it gave Iran rewards, as it did by lifting sanctions, for stopping their uranium enrichment, but did not address Iran's misbehavior.
sentences.zh: 这里的问题是根本性的。

sentences.en: And this is the General Soleimani type misbehavior in other areas.
sentences.zh: 我们用1500亿美元奖励了世界头号支持恐怖主义的国家，而我们却什么也没有得到。

sentences.en: The problem here is fundamental.
sentences.zh: 当我们退出伊核协议时，我们对伊朗重新实施了制裁，并对该国施加了更严厉的制裁。

sentences.en: We've rewarded the world's leading state sponsor of terror with $150 billion, and we received absolutely nothing in return.
sentences.zh: 我们开始惩罚企业，基本上是在向世界宣告：要么和伊朗做生意，要么和美国做生意。

sentences.en: When we pulled out of the nuclear deal, we reimposed sanctions on Iran and put even stiffer sanctions on the country.
sentences.zh: 当然，世界上大多数国家都选择了美国。

sentences.en: We started to punish companies and basically told the world, you either do business with Iran or you do business with America.
sentences.zh: 这产生的后果是彻底扼杀了伊朗经济。

sentences.en: And of course, most of the world chose America.
sentences.zh: 这也是导致伊朗政权随后开始对美国升级攻击的原因所在，因为这是一个强硬派政权。

sentences.en: That had the result of completely putting a strangle on the Iranian economy.
sentences.zh: 他们显然坚信，如果他们不好过，他们就会把美国一起拖入泥潭。

sentences.en: And that is kind of what has led to the Iranian regime then starting escalating attacks against the United States, because this is a hardline regime.
sentences.zh: 但依然合乎逻辑的是，如果我们身处这样一个后伊核协议的世界，

sentences.en: where Iran decides that the only way that it can operate is with attacks through militias that it organizes against the U.S.,

sentences.zh: 我们拥有超级大国的军事能力。

sentences.en: They do not.
sentences.zh: 他们没有。

sentences.en: We have superpower military capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这并没有给他们留下太多的选择，不是吗？

sentences.zh: 你知道的，早在80年代，曾发生过一场油轮战争，当时伊朗、伊拉克和美国互相攻伐。

sentences.en: That doesn't leave them with a whole lot of options, does it?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他们把波斯湾变成了一个无法无天的地方，石油价格大幅飙升。

sentences.en: You know, back in the 80s, there was this tanker war where Iran, Iraq and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 最终结果是美国误击了一架伊朗客机。

sentences.en: were all going after each other.
sentences.zh: 那件事发生后，伊朗闹腾了一阵，随后便安静了下来。

sentences.en: And, you know, they made the Persian Gulf like an impossible place and the price of oil went way up.
sentences.zh: 所以是有先例可循的。

sentences.en: And it ended up with the United States, by mistake, shooting down an Iranian passenger jet.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，他们这次不肯罢休的可能性同样很大。

sentences.en: And Iran made a lot of noise after that happened, and then they quieted down.
sentences.zh: 伊朗有很多选项可以让我们吃苦头。

sentences.en: So there's precedent for that.
